name: 轻柔坐姿瑜伽
instructions: 只在舒适范围内缓慢伸展，不适就停。
image_prompt: a person doing gentle seated yoga stretches on a mat
suitable_for_en: After sitting for a long time
instructions_en: Stretch slowly within a comfortable range. Stop if anything feels uncomfortable.

name: 听喜欢的轻音乐
suitable_for: 想安静下来、暂时放下任务
instructions: 调到舒适音量，听两三首熟悉的曲子。
image_prompt: a cozy listening corner with headphones and a music player
suitable_for_en: When you want a quiet break
instructions_en: Use a comfortable volume and enjoy two or three familiar pieces.

name: 慢慢吃一顿家常饭
suitable_for: 饿了、忙完后需要照顾自己
instructions: 按饥饿感安排一餐，放慢速度，不勉强进食。
image_prompt: a warm balanced home meal with rice, vegetables and an egg on a table
suitable_for_en: When you are hungry or winding down
instructions_en: Eat according to your appetite, take your time and do not force yourself to finish.

name: 林荫小路慢走
instructions: 选择安全熟悉的路线，以能轻松交谈的速度走走。
image_prompt: a person taking a relaxed stroll under autumn trees
suitable_for_en: When you want a change of scenery
instructions_en: Choose a safe, familiar route and walk at a pace that feels easy.

name: 抱毯子安静休息
instructions: 坐在舒服的位置休息，可以什么也不做。
image_prompt: a cozy sofa with cushions, a blanket and soft window light
suitable_for_en: When you feel tired and want no more tasks
instructions_en: Find a comfortable seat. It is fine to do nothing at all.

name: 读几页喜欢的书
instructions: 选择没有阅读压力的书，随时可以合上。
image_prompt: an open book and a cup of tea beside a sunlit window
suitable_for_en: When you want time away from a screen
instructions_en: Choose a book that feels easy to read. You can close it at any time.

name: 留意自然呼吸
instructions: 自然呼吸，注意空气进出，不屏息，也不刻意深吸。
image_prompt: a relaxed person sitting by a window with one hand on the belly, quietly noticing natural breathing
suitable_for_en: When you want a brief pause
instructions_en: Breathe naturally and notice the air moving. Do not hold your breath or force deep breaths.

name: 从头到脚放松片刻
instructions: 留意身体各处感受，找舒服的姿势，不追求特定效果。
image_prompt: a person resting comfortably on a sofa with a light blanket, a calm body relaxation moment
suitable_for_en: When your body feels tense
instructions_en: Notice how different parts of your body feel. Find a comfortable position without seeking a particular result.

name: 轻轻活动肩膀
instructions: 小幅慢慢耸肩、放下，保持自然呼吸，不适就停。
image_prompt: a person in loose home clothes gently rolling shoulders beside a desk
suitable_for_en: After working at a desk
instructions_en: Slowly lift and release your shoulders with small movements. Breathe naturally and stop if uncomfortable.

name: 手腕与手指舒展
instructions: 轻轻张开手指、放松手腕，不用力掰拉。
image_prompt: a close view of relaxed hands gently opening fingers and stretching wrists above a wooden desk
suitable_for_en: After typing or writing
instructions_en: Gently open your fingers and relax your wrists. Do not pull or force the joints.

name: 坐着活动脚踝
instructions: 坐稳后缓慢转动脚踝，动作轻小，不适就停。
image_prompt: a person seated safely on a chair gently moving ankles, soft socks and a cozy rug
suitable_for_en: After sitting for a while
instructions_en: Sit securely and move your ankles slowly with small, comfortable movements.

name: 站起来舒展身体
instructions: 站稳后轻轻伸展手臂和背部，不追求幅度。
image_prompt: a person standing comfortably near a wall and gently stretching arms upward in a sunlit room
suitable_for_en: When you want to change position
instructions_en: Stand steadily and gently stretch your arms and back without forcing the range.

name: 窗边坐一会儿
instructions: 避开刺眼光线，坐在舒适的地方看看窗外。
image_prompt: a cozy armchair beside a sunlit window with soft curtains, a person quietly resting
suitable_for_en: When you want to quietly look outside
instructions_en: Avoid harsh glare and sit somewhere comfortable with a view.

name: 看看慢慢飘过的云
instructions: 找安全的停留处看看天空，不直视太阳。
image_prompt: a person sitting on a park bench watching soft clouds drift across a blue sky
suitable_for_en: When you want your attention to slow down
instructions_en: Choose a safe place to pause and look at the sky. Do not look directly at the sun.

name: 听一会儿鸟鸣
instructions: 在安全安静处听周围声音，不必辨认每一种鸟。
image_prompt: small birds on leafy branches near a quiet park bench in gentle morning light
suitable_for_en: When you want a moment with nature
instructions_en: Listen to the sounds around you in a safe, quiet place. There is no need to identify each bird.

name: 水边看一会儿波纹
instructions: 在有护栏的安全步道停留，看看水面，不靠近水边。
image_prompt: a safe riverside walkway with a railing and a person observing gentle ripples from a bench
suitable_for_en: When you want a different view
instructions_en: Stay on a safe path behind a railing and watch the water from a distance.

name: 逛一小段花园
instructions: 选择平坦安全的小径，按精力决定走多远。
image_prompt: a person strolling slowly along a flat garden path surrounded by flowers and green plants
suitable_for_en: When you want to see greenery
instructions_en: Choose a flat, safe path and decide how far to go according to your energy.

name: 拍三张日常小照片
instructions: 拍拍树叶、光影或杯子，不追求作品质量。
image_prompt: a person taking a casual photograph of fallen leaves with a phone on a quiet sidewalk
suitable_for_en: When you want to notice small pleasures
instructions_en: Photograph leaves, light or a cup. You do not need to produce a perfect picture.

name: 照顾一盆小植物
suitable_for: 想做一件轻巧具体的事
instructions: 看看土壤、擦擦叶子，按植物实际需要浇水。
image_prompt: hands gently caring for a small potted plant and wiping its leaves on a windowsill
suitable_for_en: When you want a simple, hands-on task
instructions_en: Check the soil, wipe the leaves and water only as the plant needs.

name: 把花枝放进花瓶
instructions: 用手边已有的花或枝叶简单摆放，不必买新东西。
image_prompt: hands arranging a few simple flowers in a small ceramic vase on a warm wooden table
suitable_for_en: When you want a softer space
instructions_en: Use flowers or branches you already have. There is no need to buy anything.

name: 泡一杯温茶
suitable_for: 想留一点慢下来的仪式感
instructions: 选自己习惯的饮品，注意水温；临睡前可选无咖啡因。
image_prompt: a steaming cup of caffeine-free herbal tea, a ceramic teapot and soft window light
name_en: Make a warm cup of tea
suitable_for_en: When you want a small, calming ritual
instructions_en: Choose a familiar drink at a comfortable temperature. A caffeine-free option may suit bedtime.

name: 慢慢喝一杯温水
instructions: 按口渴感小口喝水，温度以舒适为准。
image_prompt: hands holding a plain glass of warm water at a quiet kitchen table
name_en: Sip a glass of warm water
suitable_for_en: When you are thirsty or want a pause
instructions_en: Take small sips according to thirst. The temperature should feel comfortable.

name: 准备一小份水果
suitable_for: 想吃点东西、需要轻松的准备活动
instructions: 按需要准备喜欢的水果，洗净后慢慢吃。
image_prompt: a small plate of freshly washed sliced fruit on a cozy kitchen counter
suitable_for_en: When you want a simple snack
instructions_en: Wash and prepare fruit you enjoy, then eat at your own pace.

name: 煮一碗简单热汤
instructions: 用熟悉的食材简单煮汤，注意热源和烫伤，按需要进食。
image_prompt: a small pot of vegetable soup simmering gently in a cozy home kitchen with a bowl nearby
suitable_for_en: When you want to take care of a meal
instructions_en: Use familiar ingredients and take care around heat and hot liquids. Eat according to your needs.

name: 做一道熟悉的小菜
suitable_for: 想通过简单做饭切换节奏
instructions: 挑一道熟悉、步骤少的菜，不赶时间，注意厨房安全。
image_prompt: hands preparing a simple home vegetable dish in a warm tidy kitchen
suitable_for_en: When cooking might help you change pace
instructions_en: Choose a familiar recipe with few steps. Take your time and keep the kitchen safe.

name: 听一段轻柔雨声
instructions: 用舒适音量播放雨声，觉得不喜欢就换掉。
image_prompt: rain droplets on a window beside a small speaker and a warm reading lamp
suitable_for_en: When you want a quieter background
instructions_en: Play rain sounds at a comfortable volume. Choose something else if you do not enjoy them.

name: 听一首舒缓钢琴曲
suitable_for: 想给自己一段安静的时间
instructions: 只听一两首喜欢的曲子，不必强迫自己专注。
image_prompt: a cozy room with a piano, sheet music and warm light suggesting gentle piano listening
name_en: Listen to a quiet piano piece
suitable_for_en: When you want some peaceful time
instructions_en: Listen to one or two pieces you like. You do not need to force your attention.

name: 重听一首喜欢的歌
instructions: 选一首让自己舒服的歌，音量不要太大。
image_prompt: a person smiling softly while listening to a favorite song with headphones in a cozy chair
suitable_for_en: When you want a familiar comfort
instructions_en: Choose a song that feels good to you and keep the volume comfortable.

name: 轻轻哼一段旋律
instructions: 用自然舒适的声音哼几句，不憋气，不追求唱好。
image_prompt: a relaxed person softly humming while sitting near a sunlit window, a small music player nearby
suitable_for_en: When you want gentle self-expression
instructions_en: Hum softly in a natural voice without holding your breath or trying to sing perfectly.

name: 跟着音乐轻轻摇摆
suitable_for: 想轻微活动又不想运动
instructions: 在安全不滑的空间小幅摇摆，站不舒服也可以坐着。
image_prompt: a person gently swaying to music in a clear cozy living room with a small speaker
suitable_for_en: When you want a little light movement
instructions_en: Make small movements in a safe, non-slip space. You can stay seated if you prefer.

name: 随手画几笔
suitable_for: 想让手动起来、暂时放下任务
instructions: 用纸笔随意画线条，不评价画得好不好。
image_prompt: a sketchbook filled with casual playful doodles and a hand holding a pencil on a desk
suitable_for_en: When you want your hands to do something simple
instructions_en: Draw any lines or shapes you like without judging the result.

name: 给简单图案涂颜色
suitable_for: 想做一件重复、轻松的事
instructions: 选喜欢的颜色慢慢涂，没涂完也可以停下。
image_prompt: colored pencils and a simple botanical coloring page partly colored on a cream wooden desk
suitable_for_en: When you want a quiet, repetitive activity
instructions_en: Choose colors you enjoy and go slowly. It is fine to stop before finishing.

name: 画一小片水彩色块
instructions: 用已有画材随意铺几块颜色，重在过程。
image_prompt: hands painting soft watercolor color swatches on paper with a brush and a small watercolor palette
suitable_for_en: When you want to explore color
instructions_en: Use materials you already have to make a few simple color patches. Enjoy the process.

name: 折一张简单纸船
instructions: 用一张废纸跟着简单步骤折，不必整齐完美。
image_prompt: hands folding a simple paper boat beside a few finished pastel paper boats on a table
suitable_for_en: When you want a small craft project
instructions_en: Follow a few easy steps with scrap paper. It does not need to look perfect.

name: 捏一小团软陶或黏土
instructions: 选安全材料，轻捏成喜欢的小形状，完成后洗手。
image_prompt: hands gently shaping a small piece of soft modeling clay into a simple rounded form
suitable_for_en: When you want a hands-on sensory activity
instructions_en: Use safe materials, shape them gently and wash your hands afterwards.

name: 拼几块小拼图
suitable_for: 想轻松地集中一下注意力
instructions: 只拼一小块区域，不给自己规定完成量。
image_prompt: a partially assembled small landscape jigsaw puzzle and loose pieces on a wooden table
suitable_for_en: When you want an easy focus
instructions_en: Work on a small section without setting a target for how much to complete.

name: 写一张不必寄出的明信片
instructions: 写给自己或熟悉的人，是否寄出以后再决定。
image_prompt: a blank postcard, a pen and a small flower on a desk, a hand writing without readable text
name_en: Write a postcard you need not send
suitable_for_en: When you want to express appreciation or connection
instructions_en: Write to yourself or someone familiar. You can decide later whether to send it.

name: 写下三件小小的好事
suitable_for: 想回看今天的温暖片刻
instructions: 可以很小，也可以只写一件；没有想到就先放下。
image_prompt: an open journal with abstract unreadable handwriting, a pen and three small star stickers
suitable_for_en: When you want to notice a warm moment
instructions_en: Small things count, and one is enough. If nothing comes to mind, leave it for now.

name: 不评判地自由写几行
instructions: 随手写下当下想法，不要求逻辑，也不必分享。
image_prompt: a person writing freely in a notebook at a quiet desk with soft lamplight, no readable text
suitable_for_en: When you have a lot on your mind
instructions_en: Write whatever comes up. It need not be organized or shared with anyone.

name: 只收拾桌面一个小角落
suitable_for: 环境有点乱、想做一件可完成的小事
instructions: 选很小的一块区域，时间到了就停，不延伸成大扫除。
image_prompt: hands tidying one small corner of a wooden desk with a notebook, a cup and a plant
name_en: Tidy one small corner of your desk
suitable_for_en: When you want a manageable task
instructions_en: Choose a very small area and stop when the time is up. It need not turn into a big cleaning session.

name: 理平被子与抱枕
suitable_for: 想让休息空间舒服一些
instructions: 只整理自己愿意动手的部分，不强求整洁。
image_prompt: a cozy bed with soft cream bedding and hands gently straightening a pillow
suitable_for_en: When you want a more comfortable resting space
instructions_en: Tidy only what you feel like adjusting. Perfect neatness is not required.

name: 洗一个舒适的温水澡
suitable_for: 忙完后想切换到休息状态
instructions: 用舒适水温，注意防滑，身体不适时调整或跳过。
image_prompt: a cozy bathroom with a warm shower, folded towels and soft steam, no person visible
suitable_for_en: When you want to shift into resting mode
instructions_en: Use a comfortable temperature and take care not to slip. Adjust or skip it if unwell.

name: 用温毛巾擦擦手和脸
suitable_for: 想做一点简单的自我照顾
instructions: 毛巾温度以舒适为准，轻轻擦拭，不热敷敏感部位。
image_prompt: a folded warm damp towel and a ceramic basin on a calm bathroom counter
suitable_for_en: When you want a little simple self-care
instructions_en: Use a comfortably warm towel and wipe gently. Avoid hot compresses on sensitive areas.

name: 抱着柔软靠垫放松
instructions: 挑喜欢的毯子或靠垫，找不压迫呼吸的姿势坐一会儿。
image_prompt: a person comfortably hugging a soft cushion on a cream sofa with a light blanket
suitable_for_en: When you want a comforting texture
instructions_en: Choose a blanket or cushion and a position that does not restrict your breathing.

name: 让屏幕休息十分钟
suitable_for: 刷屏或工作后想停一下
instructions: 把手机放到一边，看看远处或做点愿意做的小事。
image_prompt: a phone placed face down beside a window, a person looking outside, a quiet screen-free break
name_en: Give your screen a short break
suitable_for_en: After scrolling or working
instructions_en: Put your phone aside, look into the distance or do a small activity you enjoy.

name: 和信任的人轻松聊几句
instructions: 先问对方是否方便，聊点轻松的事，不强求回应。
image_prompt: two friends chatting comfortably over warm drinks in a cozy quiet sitting room
name_en: Have a light chat with someone you trust
suitable_for_en: When you want a little company
instructions_en: Check whether they have time and share something ordinary. Do not expect an immediate reply.

name: 给自己写一句温柔的话
suitable_for: 想少一点苛责、多一点体谅
instructions: 写一句自己能接受的话，不必刻意积极。
image_prompt: a hand placing a small blank note beside a journal and a cup of tea, no readable text
suitable_for_en: When you want a little less self-criticism
instructions_en: Write something that feels believable to you. There is no need to force positivity.

name: 翻看几张喜欢的旧照片
instructions: 选让自己感到自在的照片，感受不舒服就停下。
image_prompt: hands turning pages of a small photo album with abstract warm travel snapshots
name_en: Look through a few favorite photos
suitable_for_en: When you want to remember a comfortable moment
instructions_en: Choose photos that feel good to you. Stop if they bring up uncomfortable feelings.

name: 看一小段轻松喜剧
instructions: 选熟悉、没有负担的片段，按精力控制时长。
image_prompt: a cozy sofa facing a television showing abstract cheerful colors, a warm lamp, no text or logos
suitable_for_en: When you want an easy laugh
instructions_en: Choose a familiar, undemanding clip and keep the length comfortable for your energy.

name: 留意身边五样小东西
instructions: 随意看看颜色、形状或触感，不要求顺序，不舒服就停。
image_prompt: a quiet tabletop with five everyday objects: a smooth stone, a leaf, a ceramic cup, a pencil and a small flower
name_en: Notice five small things around you
suitable_for_en: When you want to bring attention to the present
instructions_en: Notice colors, shapes or textures in any order. Stop if it feels uncomfortable.
